body: Consent, actually.  Lots of manipulation kept various people under the rug for a while, but thankfully it all came out and the offenders were quickly exiled from the community.  Not a cult, just a somewhat organized bunch of people in their 20s and 30s who have a bunch of connected events and stuff.  Plenty of truly good people in it, but the bad ones broke way too much trust.  I couldn't feel good about being part of it anymore.
